_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for colourways and availability.
Edit ONLY this file, then commit and push. Every product page and the shop
grid read it at load — you never need to touch the HTML to change stock.
stock  = units on hand for that colour. Set it to 0 and the site marks that
colour sold out and disables the add-to-cart button.
colour = must match the option name you set in the Snipcart dashboard
EXACTLY, or Snipcart will reject the order.
note   = optional line under the swatches. Leave out if not needed.
This file controls what the SITE says. Snipcart's dashboard controls what
can actually be BOUGHT. Keep the two in step.

og-bass-walker.note: Hand-painted and signed — one of each colour
